task_instruction: 示例（非正式测试案例）：围绕硫化物/石榴石固态电解质界面工程，分析 2019–2025 年产出趋势、主题演化、各阶段代表作与研究空白，并说明统计口径。

output_contract.研究产物: 趋势表、演化序列、代表作清单与空白清单
output_contract.不确定性: 口径、冲突与不可判定项

topic: solid-state electrolyte interface engineering: interphase, ion transport, dendrite

records.title: Interphase formation in garnet solid electrolytes probed by XPS
records.abstract: We probe interphase formation at the garnet/lithium interface with XPS and relate it to interfacial resistance.

records.title: Dendrite penetration through grain boundaries in LLZO
records.abstract: Lithium dendrites penetrate along grain boundaries of LLZO and cause short circuit; we quantify the critical current density.

records.title: Ionic conductivity of sulfide solid electrolytes at low temperature
records.abstract: Ionic conductivity of sulfide solid electrolytes drops sharply at low temperature; transport mechanisms are discussed.

records.title: Wetting of lithium metal on garnet surfaces
records.abstract: Lithium wetting on garnet surfaces governs interfacial contact; we compare surface treatments.

records.title: Operando optical microscopy of lithium plating
records.abstract: Operando optical microscopy resolves plating morphology in situ during cycling.

records.title: Interfacial resistance and dendrite nucleation in garnet cells
records.abstract: Dendrite nucleation correlates with interfacial resistance in garnet cells.

records.title: Phase stability of sulfide electrolytes against lithium
records.abstract: Phase stability of sulfide electrolytes against lithium metal is examined with diffraction.

records.title: Impedance spectroscopy of grain boundaries in solid electrolytes
records.abstract: Impedance spectroscopy separates grain and grain-boundary contributions in solid electrolytes.

records.title: Machine learning potential for ion transport in sulfide electrolytes
records.abstract: A machine learning potential reproduces ion transport in sulfide electrolytes; however, the transferability to interfaces remains unclear.

records.title: Operando tomography of lithium filament growth
records.abstract: Operando tomography tracks lithium filament growth inside the electrolyte in situ.

records.title: Dendrite nucleation correlated with interfacial resistance in garnet cells
records.abstract: Interfacial resistance and dendrite nucleation are measured across garnet cells and correlated.

records.title: DFT study of migration barriers at the LLZO interface
records.abstract: DFT calculations give migration barriers for ion transport across the LLZO interface.

records.title: Cryo-EM imaging of interphases in solid-state cells
records.abstract: Cryo-EM resolves beam-sensitive interphases at the nanoscale.

records.title: Molecular dynamics of ion transport across the interphase
records.abstract: Molecular dynamics quantifies ion transport across a modelled interphase.

records.title: Compressive stress effects on lithium plating morphology
records.abstract: Applied compressive stress changes plating morphology and delays filament onset.

records.title: Photocatalytic CO2 reduction on titania
records.abstract: Photocatalytic CO2 reduction on titania under visible light.

records.title: Polymer electrolyte interfaces for fast charging
records.abstract: Polymer electrolyte interfaces enable fast charging; interfacial stability is the limiting factor.

records.title: Ionic conductivity benchmarking across laboratories
records.abstract: Round-robin ionic conductivity measurements disagree across laboratories; the origin remains unclear.

records.title: Ionic conductivity benchmarking across laboratories
records.abstract: Preprint of the conductivity benchmarking study.

records.title: Pouch cell integration of sulfide electrolytes with high areal loading
records.abstract: Pouch cells with sulfide electrolytes reach high areal loading; scale-up losses are quantified.

records.title: Machine learning potential accelerated screening of interface coatings
records.abstract: Machine learning potentials accelerate screening of interface coatings for sulfide electrolytes.

records.title: Dendrite suppression by interphase engineering in pouch cells
records.abstract: Interphase engineering suppresses dendrite growth in pouch cells.

records.title: In situ NMR of ion transport in composite cathodes
records.abstract: In situ NMR resolves ion transport in composite cathodes during cycling.

records.title: Recycling of garnet solid electrolytes
records.abstract: Garnet solid electrolytes can be recycled, but the field lacks a validated closed-loop route.

records.title: Interphase evolution under high voltage in sulfide cells
records.abstract: Interphase evolution under high voltage remains challenging for sulfide cells.

records.title: Dendrite-free plating enabled by interphase design
records.abstract: Designed interphases deliver dendrite-free plating at high current density.

records.abstract: A record with no usable year field, kept to show honest missing-year accounting for ionic conductivity topics.
